title: A count correction travels forward
hook: The record says ten, the shelf has eight. Which count remains after shipping three?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Propagate a counted inventory discrepancy through a later transaction.

misconception: A later dispatch automatically fixes an earlier inventory error.
objective: Propagate a counted inventory discrepancy through a later transaction.

claims.text: The physical count is two below the record. Three units are then dispatched. Scaled model; count difference=2; dispatch=3; no receipts.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Record=10, A=5items and B=7items. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-","x",5]; B=["-","x",3]; x denotes Record. At x=10, A=5, B=7. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Subtract the discrepancy before updating the dispatch. Shipping three from an already incorrect record preserves its two-unit error. A corrected observation needs to travel into the next calculation.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["-","x",5]; B=["-","x",3]; x denotes Record. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The record says 20 units, but a physical count finds 17. You then dispatch four. How many are really left? Correct: 13. Correct the record to the count first (17), then subtract the dispatch: 13. The record's 16 keeps the old error.
